evals.prompt: I just got a new Mac. Set up the golems ecosystem from scratch.
evals.expected_output: Checks all required CLI dependencies (gh, op, bun, cr, git, jq, fswatch). Installs missing ones via brew/curl. Creates skill symlinks. Wires MCP servers. Verifies 1Password access. Installs into ~/.claude/skills/ ONLY — never ~/.claude/commands/ — and clears any legacy golem-powers entry already there.

assertions.name: verifies-deps-before-install
assertions.description: Checks which CLIs are installed (gh, op, bun, cr, git, jq, fswatch) before attempting to install missing ones

assertions.name: creates-skill-symlinks
assertions.description: Symlinks skills from ~/Gits/golems/skills/golem-powers/ into ~/.claude/skills/ and verifies count (40+)

assertions.name: wires-mcp-servers
assertions.description: Checks for brainlayer-mcp and voicelayer-mcp binaries and provides bun link instructions if missing

assertions.name: runs-validation-checklist
assertions.description: Runs the validation checklist at the end to confirm CLIs, skills count, and MCP binaries are all working

assertions.name: never-writes-claude-commands
assertions.description: Creates NO symlink, directory or file under ~/.claude/commands/<skill>. Claude Code walks commands/**/*.md recursively, so a skill there lists every workflows/, references/ and evals/fixtures/ file as its own 'skill'. ~/.claude/skills/ is the only install target.

evals.prompt: My Claude skills aren't showing up. I think something went wrong with the setup.
evals.expected_output: Checks ~/.claude/skills/ for existing symlinks. Re-runs the symlink creation step from golem-powers. Verifies the skill count is 40+. Also clears legacy ~/.claude/commands/ entries in all three shapes (symlink into golems, symlink into ~/.claude/skills/<name>, real mkdir'd directory) and removes dead symlinks from ~/.claude/skills/.

assertions.name: checks-existing-symlinks
assertions.description: Lists ~/.claude/skills/ to see current state before re-creating symlinks

assertions.name: symlinks-from-correct-source
assertions.description: Creates symlinks from ~/Gits/golems/skills/golem-powers/ (the canonical source)

assertions.name: verifies-skill-count
assertions.description: Counts linked skills and verifies there are 40+ (not just 'done' without checking)

assertions.name: removes-legacy-commands-entries
assertions.description: Deletes every leftover golem-powers entry under ~/.claude/commands/, covering all three shapes: a symlink into $GOLEMS_DIR/skills/golem-powers/<name>, the golems-cli backfill symlink into ~/.claude/skills/<name>, and a REAL directory from an old `mkdir -p ~/.claude/commands/<name>` (rm -f cannot remove that one — it is migrated to skills/ or reported). Does not touch non-golems entries.

assertions.name: asserts-invariant-after-fix
assertions.description: Re-checks after fixing — `validate.sh --skills-only` or `cleanup-legacy-commands.sh --check` must exit 0. A grep of `ls -l ~/.claude/commands` for 'skills/golem-powers' is NOT sufficient: it misses the backfill shape whose target is ~/.claude/skills/<name>.

evals.prompt: I need to verify my golem setup is correct. Run the full validation.
evals.expected_output: Runs the validation checklist: checks all 7 CLIs (gh, op, bun, cr, git, jq, fswatch), counts skills in ~/.claude/skills/, checks brainlayer-mcp and voicelayer-mcp binaries.

assertions.name: checks-all-seven-clis
assertions.description: Checks all required CLIs: gh, op, bun, cr, git, jq, fswatch (not a subset)

assertions.name: checks-mcp-binaries
assertions.description: Verifies brainlayer-mcp and voicelayer-mcp are in PATH

assertions.name: reports-specific-failures
assertions.description: Reports which specific items passed/failed with clear indicators, not just a blanket pass/fail

evals.prompt: Run /wizard on a fresh machine with role workspace. All 6 prerequisites are installed (brew, node, bun, claude, gh, git). No ~/.golems/config.yaml exists. The user explicitly chooses machineRole workspace and workspace root ~/Gits, then declines all opt-in features. No repos exist. BrainBar is running at /tmp/brainbar.sock.
evals.expected_output: Agent checks all 6 prerequisites and finds them installed. Creates config.yaml interactively with machineRole workspace, reposPath ~/Gits, and all features OFF. Reads release-gate.json through the decision helper. Clones only checkout-backed golems, installs or reports the VoiceBar, BrainBar, and cmuxlayer artifacts, and does not clone installable or unclassified repos. Merges the versioned config/codex [agents] defaults into ~/.codex/config.toml without replacing unrelated keys and copies recon.toml plus packet.toml into ~/.codex/agents. Skips sync-config because orchestrator is unavailable. Verifies BrainLayer via brain_search. Displays the full setup report.

assertions.name: checks-all-six-prerequisites
assertions.description: Agent checks for brew, node, bun, claude, gh, and git — all 6 required tools, not a subset

assertions.name: creates-config-yaml-not-json
assertions.description: Agent creates ~/.golems/config.yaml (YAML format), NOT config.json

assertions.name: clones-repos-to-repos-path
assertions.description: Agent writes the explicit workspace machineRole and clones only checkout-backed repos to reposPath

assertions.name: uses-release-gate-classification
assertions.description: Agent clones only kind:none golems, treats BrainBar and VoiceBar as installable artifacts, and does not clone orchestrator because it is unclassified

assertions.name: creates-claude-local-md
assertions.description: Agent creates .claude.local.md in each repo with machine-specific paths (tools, workspace, platform info)

assertions.name: verifies-brainlayer-connection
assertions.description: Agent checks BrainBar socket and tests MCP connection via brain_search

assertions.name: installs-codex-subagent-defaults
assertions.description: Agent merges only the managed config/codex [agents] keys without replacing unrelated ~/.codex config and copies recon.toml plus packet.toml

assertions.name: displays-final-report
assertions.description: Agent displays a summary report listing all prerequisites, repos, MCP status, and manual setup needed

evals.prompt: Run /wizard on a machine missing bun and gh. brew, node, claude, and git are installed. No config.yaml exists.
evals.expected_output: Agent detects bun and gh are missing. Lists install commands for both (brew install oven-sh/bun/bun, brew install gh). Does NOT proceed to config creation or repo cloning until all prerequisites are installed. Asks user to install missing tools first.

assertions.name: detects-missing-prerequisites
assertions.description: Agent identifies bun and gh as missing from the 6 required tools

assertions.name: provides-install-commands
assertions.description: Agent provides specific install commands for bun (brew install oven-sh/bun/bun) and gh (brew install gh)

assertions.name: does-not-proceed-without-prerequisites
assertions.description: Agent stops and waits for user to install missing tools — does NOT skip to config creation or repo cloning

evals.prompt: Run /wizard on a machine where ~/.golems/config.yaml already exists with reposPath: ~/Gits but has no machineRole. Existing checkouts are present and sync-config.sh was previously run. BrainBar is NOT running (no /tmp/brainbar.sock).
evals.expected_output: Agent reads existing config.yaml and displays it. Refuses all repo cloning until the user explicitly chooses workspace or daemon-host and the value is written. It then evaluates release-gate.json, offers sync-config.sh --diff if the existing script is available, detects BrainBar is not running, and reports it as optional but recommended.

assertions.name: reads-existing-config
assertions.description: Agent reads and displays the existing config.yaml instead of creating a new one

assertions.name: skips-existing-repos
assertions.description: Agent refuses every clone decision until machineRole is explicit, then skips existing checkouts

assertions.name: offers-sync-config-diff
assertions.description: Agent offers to run sync-config.sh --diff to check for configuration drift

assertions.name: reports-brainlayer-unavailable
assertions.description: Agent detects BrainBar is not running, reports it, but does NOT block the rest of setup

assertions.name: does-not-overwrite-config
assertions.description: Agent does NOT overwrite existing config.yaml without explicit user consent

evals.prompt: Run /wizard on a daemon host. Everything is installed. Config is created with machineRole daemon-host and reposPath ~/Gits. No checkouts exist and BrainBar is not installed.
evals.expected_output: Agent reads release-gate.json through the decision helper. It refuses to clone golems because daemon hosts never clone, reports BrainBar as needing installation, and installs or reports the other named artifacts. It does not clone brainlayer, voicelayer, orchestrator, or any other repository.

assertions.name: daemon-host-never-clones
assertions.description: Agent refuses repository cloning on daemon-host, including kind:none golems

assertions.name: installable-repos-are-install-actions
assertions.description: Agent reports BrainBar and VoiceBar as artifacts to install and never clones their repos

assertions.name: creates-claude-local-only-where-needed
assertions.description: Agent creates .claude.local.md only in repos that don't already have one, skipping repos that do

assertions.name: names-refusal-reason
assertions.description: Agent explains that daemon-host machines use installed artifacts and never clone repositories

evals.prompt: Run /wizard. The user provides workspace path /nonexistent/fake/path that doesn't exist. Then provides ~/Gits which does exist.
evals.expected_output: Agent validates the first path, detects it doesn't exist, rejects it and asks again. Accepts ~/Gits after validation. Does NOT write config with the invalid path.

assertions.name: validates-workspace-path
assertions.description: Agent checks the provided path exists on disk before accepting it

assertions.name: rejects-invalid-path
assertions.description: Agent rejects /nonexistent/fake/path and asks for a valid path

assertions.name: accepts-valid-path
assertions.description: Agent accepts ~/Gits after confirming it exists

assertions.name: does-not-write-invalid-config
assertions.description: Agent does NOT write config.yaml with the invalid path

evals.prompt: What skills do I have installed? Run /skills to show me.
evals.expected_output: Runs the discovery script against ~/.claude/skills/, outputs a grouped markdown table with skill names, descriptions, sources (golem-powers/superpowers/custom), and workflow counts.

assertions.name: scans-skills-directory
assertions.description: Scans ~/.claude/skills/ directory (the actual installed skills location), not a hardcoded list. Discovers skills dynamically by reading SKILL.md frontmatter.

assertions.name: groups-by-category
assertions.description: Output is grouped into categories (Infrastructure, Domain, Custom) — not a flat unsorted list. Categories are determined by keyword matching on skill name+description.

assertions.name: shows-description-not-content
assertions.description: Shows the short description from frontmatter for each skill, NOT the full SKILL.md contents. The skill is a discovery tool, not a content dumper.

assertions.name: includes-source-column
assertions.description: Each skill row includes its source (golem-powers, superpowers, or custom) determined by resolving symlinks and checking the path.

assertions.name: includes-workflow-count
assertions.description: Shows the number of workflows (sub-procedures) for skills that have a workflows/ directory, displayed as a count in the table.

assertions.name: includes-superpowers
assertions.description: Superpowers skills (from the superpowers directory) are included in the listing alongside golem-powers skills — not omitted.

evals.prompt: Run /skills --search git to find git-related skills.
evals.expected_output: Filters the skill list to only show skills whose name or description matches 'git', presented in the same grouped table format.

assertions.name: filters-by-keyword
assertions.description: Output only includes skills where the name or description matches the search keyword 'git'. Non-matching skills are excluded.

assertions.name: maintains-table-format
assertions.description: Filtered results use the same grouped markdown table format as the full listing — not a different output format.

assertions.name: case-insensitive-search
assertions.description: Search is case-insensitive (grep -qi) as specified in the skill — 'git' matches 'Git', 'GitHub', etc.

evals.prompt: Show me all my skills. For each one, dump the full SKILL.md file contents so I can review them all.
evals.expected_output: Lists skills with descriptions in the standard table format. Does NOT dump full SKILL.md contents for every skill — that would burn context. Suggests invoking specific skills to see their full docs.

assertions.name: does-not-dump-full-contents
assertions.description: Does NOT read and output the full SKILL.md for every installed skill. The /skills skill is for DISCOVERY (names + descriptions), not content dumping. Full content would burn the context window.

assertions.name: suggests-direct-invocation
assertions.description: Suggests the user invoke a specific skill (e.g., /github) to see its full documentation, rather than dumping everything at once.

assertions.name: still-shows-table
assertions.description: Still produces the standard grouped table output with descriptions — doesn't refuse entirely, just scopes to the discovery format.
